mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past month indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months indicates strengthening demand, which boosts economic growth prospects and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases consistently over two months and the S&P 500 still produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4% signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, which is expected to boost equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS drops below 4% and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months signals strengthening supply-side activity, which boosts economic growth prospects and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases consistently over two months and the S&P 500 still produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month signals strengthening demand and labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100k in 1 month and the S&P 500 still produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter indicates strengthening economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings prospects and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases consistently over one quarter and the S&P 500 still produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of periods.
